text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Fitted ivory elbow-length short-sleeve Henley with deep round neckline and a long row of small gold buttons, medium-blue washed straight-wide jeans, white slim sneakers with black sole.. Add ONLY these accessories: Oversized soft white canvas tote with two long thick handles and faint tonal outlined decorative emblem; Silver round light-dial wristwatch with metal bracelet; Fine simple gold chain necklace with tiny pendant and complete clasp. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved hollow garment ensemble. Preserve its EXACT clothing, layering, silhouette, colors, shoes and material. Input image 2 is original styling reference, ONLY for the accessories listed below. Create one complete styled outfit on a pure uniform WHITE seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light, full uncropped framing. Add ONLY these 3 listed accessories, no other objects: 1. Oversized soft white canvas tote with two long thick handles and faint tonal outlined decorative emblem; 2. Silver round light-dial wristwatch with metal bracelet; 3. Fine simple gold chain necklace with tiny pendant and complete clasp. Attach those listed accessories naturally to the garment at realistic scale where possible; otherwise display the small listed object neatly adjacent. STRICT: do NOT add any unlisted hat, cap, eyeglasses, sunglasses, handbag, belt, jewelry, props or footwear. No person, skin, body parts, head, face, hands, visible mannequin, stand, text captions or watermark. Empty neckline and sleeves.
